exams.name: Oregon Medical Board examination
exams.notes: Average score of not less than 75 required for passing. Board may require the FLEX exam.
exams.quote: Applicants who satisfy the requirements of ORS 677.100 shall be admitted to an examination in subjects covered in schools of medicine that grant degrees of Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine. In all such examinations an average score of not less than 75 is required for passing.

exams.name: Federation Licensing Examination (FLEX)
exams.notes: Board may require the FLEX in lieu of or alongside its own exam.
exams.quote: The Oregon Medical Board may require the applicant to take and pass the Federation Licensing Examination, also known as FLEX.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Accepted in lieu of the board's own examination.
exams.quote: The Oregon Medical Board may accept a certificate issued by the National Board of Medical Examiners of the United States or the National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons or the Medical Council of Canada or successful completion of the United States Medical Licensing Examination in lieu of its own examination.

available.quote: The Oregon Medical Board may enter into agreements with medical or osteopathic examining boards of other states and territories of the United States, and the District of Columbia, having qualifications and standards at least as high as those of this state, providing for reciprocal licensing in this state, without further examination, of persons who have been licensed upon written examination in the other state or territory.

requirements.value: Must have qualifications and standards at least as high as Oregon's; must have been licensed upon written examination in the other state or territory. Expedited endorsement also available for physicians who practiced their specialty for at least one year and have no disciplinary history.
requirements.quote: having qualifications and standards at least as high as those of this state, providing for reciprocal licensing in this state, without further examination, of persons who have been licensed upon written examination in the other state or territory

title_protection.quote: Except as provided in ORS 677.060, append the letters "M.D.," "D.O." or "P.A." to the person's name, or use the words "Doctor," "Physician," "Surgeon," "Physician Associate," or any abbreviation or combination thereof

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices medicine without being licensed under this chapter as prohibited in ORS 677.080 (4) commits a Class C felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct unbecoming a licensee or detrimental to public interest, including unethical conduct or conduct endangering patient safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional or dishonorable conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing any person to solicit patients for the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing any person to solicit patients for the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition can be cured.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition of sickness, disease or injury can be cured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or negligently divulging a professional secret without written patient consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or negligently divulging a professional secret without the written consent of the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any offense punishable by incarceration in a Department of Corrections institution or federal prison.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this subsection, conviction of any offense punishable by incarceration in a Department of Corrections institution or in a federal prison

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment as defined in ORS 676.303.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment as defined in ORS 676.303.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license to practice in this state, or in connection with applying for or procuring registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading statements about skill, efficacy or value of medicine or treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making statements that the licensee knows, or with the exercise of reasonable care should know, are false or misleading, regarding skill or the efficacy or value of the medicine, treatment or remedy prescribed or administered by the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating another licensee or permitting another to use the licensee's license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating another licensee licensed under this chapter or permitting or allowing any person to use the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine or podiatry by an unlicensed person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine or podiatry by a person not licensed by the board, when the licensee knows, or with the exercise of reasonable care should know, that the person is not licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the licensee's name with a professional degree designation in untruthful or deceptive advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using the name of the licensee under the designation "doctor," "Dr.," "D.O." or "M.D.," "D.P.M.," "Acupuncturist," "P.A." or any similar designation in any form of advertising that is untruthful or is intended to deceive or mislead the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence or repeated negligence in the practice of medicine or podiatry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence or repeated negligence in the practice of medicine or podiatry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incapacity to practice medicine or podiatry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incapacity to practice medicine or podiatry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by another state based on acts similar to those in this section.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this subsection, disciplinary action by another state of a license to practice, based upon acts by the licensee similar to acts described in this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to designate the degree appearing on the license as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to designate the degree appearing on the license under circumstances described in ORS 677.184 (3).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully violating any provision of this chapter, board rule, board order, or failing to comply with a board request.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully violating any provision of this chapter or any rule adopted by the board, board order, or failing to comply with a board request pursuant to ORS 677.320.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report the change of location of practice as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report the change of the location of practice of the licensee as required by ORS 677.172.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Imprisonment as provided in ORS 677.225.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Imprisonment as provided in ORS 677.225.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a fraudulent claim.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a fraudulent claim.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing psychosurgery.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing psychosurgery.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing an invitation for an informal interview with the board requested under ORS 677.415.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing an invitation for an informal interview with the board requested under ORS 677.415.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the federal Controlled Substances Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the federal Controlled Substances Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing controlled substances without a legitimate medical purpose, without proper examination, or without proper record keeping.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing controlled substances without a legitimate medical purpose, or prescribing controlled substances without following accepted procedures for examination of patients, or prescribing controlled substances without following accepted procedures for record keeping.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing written documentation for cannabis purposes without a legitimate diagnosis or proper examination/recordkeeping.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing written documentation for purposes of ORS 475C.783 without having legitimately diagnosed a debilitating medical condition, as defined in ORS 475C.777, or without having followed accepted procedures for the examination of patients or for keeping records.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse action taken against the licensee by another licensing jurisdiction, peer review body, health care institution, professional society, government agency, law enforcement, or court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by the licensee to report to the board any adverse action taken against the licensee by another licensing jurisdiction or any peer review body, health care institution, professional or medical society or association, governmental agency, law enforcement agency or court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify the board of voluntary resignation from or voluntary limitation of staff privileges at a health care institution while under investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by the licensee to notify the board of the licensee's voluntary resignation from the staff of a health care institution or voluntary limitation of a licensee's staff privileges at the institution if that action occurs while the licensee is under investigation

definition_quote.value: A person is practicing medicine if the person does one or more of the following: (1) Advertise, hold out to the public or represent in any manner that the person is authorized to practice medicine in this state. (2) For compensation directly or indirectly received or to be received, offer or undertake to prescribe, give or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person. (3) Offer or undertake to perform any surgical operation upon any person. (4) Offer or undertake to diagnose, cure or treat in any manner, or by any means, methods, devices or instrumentalities, any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, deformity, defect or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person.

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense prescription drugs and controlled substances. Physicians may prescribe or administer controlled substances to patients in the course of treating diagnosed conditions causing pain.

license_status_types.quote: Any person licensed to practice under this chapter who changes location of practice to some other state or country shall be listed by the board as inactive ... A person licensed to practice under this chapter may retire from practice by notifying the Oregon Medical Board in writing

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Internationally trained physicians (graduates of unapproved schools) must complete three years of training in an approved program, rather than one year. Additionally, a provisional license pathway exists requiring ECFMG certification, a substantially similar degree and training program, at least three years of practice in another country, and an offer of employment at a clinical facility in Oregon.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Three years of training in an approved program if a graduate of an unapproved school of medicine.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: One year of training in an approved program if a graduate of an approved school of medicine

pain_management_education_required.quote: A person's license to practice under this chapter automatically lapses if the licensee fails to: ... Complete prior to payment of the registration fee ... a one-hour pain management education program approved by the board and developed based on recommendations of the Pain Management Commission

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician licensed under ORS 677.100 to 677.228 may use telemedicine to engage in the practice of medicine and provide health care services, including the establishment of a provider-patient relationship, the diagnosis or treatment of a medical condition or the prescription of drugs, to a patient physically located in this state. The physician is not required to be physically located in this state when engaging in the practice of medicine through telemedicine.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician licensed under ORS 677.100 to 677.228 ... may use telemedicine to engage in the practice of medicine and provide health care services, including the establishment of a provider-patient relationship, the diagnosis or treatment of a medical condition or the prescription of drugs, to a patient physically located in this state.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Upon application, the Oregon Medical Board may issue to an out-of-state physician or physician associate a license for the practice of medicine across state lines if the physician or physician associate holds a full, unrestricted license to practice medicine in any other state of the United States

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician associate may not practice medicine unless the physician associate has entered into a collaboration agreement signed by a physician, podiatric physician or employer.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A physician associate is authorized to write prescriptions, including prescriptions for controlled substances listed in Schedules II through V. Physician associates may also register with the board for authority to dispense prescription drugs, but may not dispense controlled substances classified in Schedule I or II.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician associate is authorized to write prescriptions, including prescriptions for controlled substances listed in Schedules II through V.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A health care facility shall report to the Oregon Medical Board any official action taken against a licensee within 10 business days of the date of the official action.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Notwithstanding any other provisions of this chapter, the Oregon Medical Board may at any time direct and order a mental, physical or medical competency examination or any combination thereof, and make such investigation

scope__license_status_types.quote: Any person licensed to practice under this chapter who changes location of practice to some other state or country shall be listed by the board as inactive.
A person licensed to practice under this chapter may retire from practice by notifying the Oregon Medical Board in writing of such intention to retire.
When a need exists, the Oregon Medical Board may issue a limited license for a specified period to an applicant who possesses the qualifications prescribed by the rules of the board.

The surrender, retirement or other forfeiture, expiration or cancellation of a license issued by the board shall not deprive the board of its authority to institute or continue a disciplinary action against the licensee

The board may issue a limited license to practice medicine in this state to a physician who is licensed to practice medicine in another state or country and who: ... Is appointed as a full-time professor of medicine at a school of medicine in this state
On or before January 1, 2010, the Oregon Medical Board shall implement an expedited physician licensing process that allows the board to issue a license by endorsement to a qualified physician.
"Intern" means an individual who has entered into a hospital or hospitals for the first year of post-graduate training.
